name: Summit villas
summary: Sleep here only if the park accepted a registration at least one day ahead. The night is what makes the walk to Hai Vong Dai a morning, 800 m from Morin. A day ticket sends you back to the visitor center before 17:00. The room rate was not on the May 2025 tariff.
getThere: On the summit, after a registration made at least one day ahead.
